approvalRules.title: Approval rules
approvalRules.defaultHint: These rules count for every device. A group can make them stricter, and where groups disagree the strictest rule wins.
approvalRules.groupHint: Rules for the devices of this group. A kind left on “as for all devices” uses the rules for all devices. Where groups disagree, the strictest rule wins.
approvalRules.autoHint: Requests for these are installed without asking, as long as an approver decides their kind and the policy does not forbid them.

requests.autoApproved: Approved automatically. It is on its way to the device.

errors.request_blocked: Requests of this kind are not allowed on this device.
errors.admin_decides: Only an admin may decide this request.
